models_evaluated: GPT-4 with PDF+Prompt contextualization (NCCN guideline PDF)

links.outcome: Agreement with NCCN guideline-preferred therapies, with vs without guideline PDF grounding
links.effect: PDF+Prompt agreement 23/24 vs 17/24 for GPT-4 (P=0.040) and 18/24 for GPT-4o (P=0.089); prompting alone did not significantly improve agreement.
links.quote: The PDF+Prompt contextualized model demonstrated elevated agreement scores of 23/24 versus 17/24 for GPT-4 (P = 0.040) and 18/24 for GPT-4o (P = 0.089).

links.outcome: Recommendation of guideline non-concordant therapies by base GPT models
links.effect: Base GPT-4 gave non-concordant therapies in 4/12 responses and GPT-4o in 5/12; PDF+Prompt model had none.
links.quote: No PDF+Prompt model responses contained guideline non-concordant therapies in contrast to 4/12 responses for GPT4 (P = 0.093) and 5/12 responses for GPT4o (P = 0.037).

unlisted_practices: Prompt-only contextualization of LLM for guideline-aligned oncology recommendations

screen.practice: retrieval grounding with guideline PDF and prompt contextualization
screen.reason: The study directly evaluates whether augmenting an existing LLM (GPT-4) with document/guideline contextualization (PDF and prompts) improves adherence to NCCN guidelines and reduces non-concordant recommendations.
